title: My family
text: My family is big. I have two brothers, a sister, and four grandparents. I also have four uncles and aunts, and a lot of cousins. My brothers are eleven and fifteen, and my sister is seven. She is very shy. My brothers go to the gym every day and they are very strong. My parents are 47 and they're helpful and kind.

title: Noura’s family routine
text: We wake up at 6 a.m. every day and help our parents with breakfast. I set the table, and my brother clears the table after we finish. My mom sometimes gives us a ride to school, but we usually catch the bus. We can help Mom and Dad after we do our homework. We help them make dinner, take out the trash, and wash the dishes. I go to sleep at 9 p.m. On weekends, I can stay up a bit later.
